newsitem.title: USA: NYS Pataki says Queens will keep 260 state jobs.
newsitem.headline: NYS Pataki says Queens will keep 260 state jobs.

text.p: The Pataki Administration in New York state, which had planned to shift 261 workers from the New York City's Borough of Queens to Manhattan, on Thursday reversed course, saying they would stay in Queens.

Noting local elected officials had made a strong case for keeping the state workers where they were, Pataki explained "The move would have generated minimal savings, while causing significant disruption for the workers and dealing an unjustifiable blow to the economic base in downtown Jamaica."
